title: Trace-free exchange/projection reordering on the self-product
statement: Let l be prime, c a finite rational coefficient or its algebraic closure, k of characteristic p distinct from l, and Y a k-scheme. Put q:P1_Y→Y, W=P1_Y×Y P1_Y, T=Lambda_P(1)[2], F=q*, R=Rq*, and H=(-)(1)[2]. For any derived K, let nu=R(tensorShiftIso.inv) followed by inverse projection_q(K,T). Let beta:F(R T)→Rp2*(T_W) be canonical exchange followed by the first shifted-line comparison. Define S_K,V:H(FK) tensor F(V)≅H(F(K tensor V)) explicitly by tensorShiftIso, associativity, the native Koszul symmetry and the monoidal tensorator of F. Assuming projection_q(K,T), beta, exchange at H(FK), and its twisted p2 projection are invertible, J_K followed by unitTail and H(F(nu)) equals (identity_H(FK) tensor inverse beta) followed by S_K,RT. All maps are those of [def-sfb-rational-p1-second-pull-comparison], [def-sfb-rational-p1-ambient-tail] and [def-sfb-projective-ambient-unit-counit-composites]. No counit trace or completed reference occurs.

proof.text: Apply the normalized exchange/tensor square with inside T and outside K. Transport the ringed square through the module/ringed derived comparison, retaining its published projection and exchange arrows. Invert the square using hq,hb,hx.

Use the two-factor projection identity to separate the last Tate factor. The canonical pulled-line comparisons agree on the common root frame. The degree-zero rank-one line has trivial self-transposition and its degree-two shifts contribute (-1)^4=1, so this factor interchange is identity. The comparison on q*K is the pullback-composition comparison; together these are exactly secondPullComparison.

Cancel the projection and inverse projection in nu and the inverse twisted p2 projection in unitTail, using the given witnesses. Cancel the tensor-shift pairs. The resulting explicit word is identity tensor inverse beta followed by S_K,RT.
